name: row-actions
title: Row Actions
description: An inbox whose actions wait until you reach for a row: hover or focus slides the time away as Archive, Snooze and Read slide in, Snooze opens choices inside the row, and archiving or snoozing slides the row out with Undo in the footer
docs: Docs: https://notchset.dev/components/row-actions · Agent prompt: https://notchset.dev/md/row-actions.md · For the full notchset look, also add @notchset/notchset (tokens and fonts). · Needs React 19 and Tailwind CSS v4 (Tailwind 3 projects: upgrade first, see https://notchset.dev/docs/installation).

meta.useWhen: inbox, row actions, hover actions, email list, notifications list
